paper_title: New constraints on light Axion-Like Particles using Chandra Transmission Grating Spectroscopy of the powerful cluster-hosted quasar H1821+643
notes: X-ray photon-ALP oscillation constraint from Chandra HETG/LETG spectroscopy of quasar H1821+643 in cluster CL1821+643. At 99.7% CL, exclude g_agamma > 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 for m_a < 1e-12 eV (assuming beta=100). The bound is essentially flat below ~1e-12 eV; exclusion curve spans log(m_a/eV) in [-19,-10.2]. Encoded as horizontal line at 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 from 1e-19 eV to 1e-12 eV. Note conclusions section has a typo (6.3e-12) but abstract/results consistently state 6.3e-13. This is an astrophysical (stellar/cluster) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.78, 24)) | Vision: Traced 'This work, 99.7% CL' magenta lower boundary in Fig. 5.
